suggestions: convert an IN subquery to a semi-join
pre-filter a large table as a CTE before the join
optimized_sql:
SELECT 
    dt.d_year,
    item.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
    item.i_brand AS brand,
    SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM 
    date_dim dt
INNER JOIN 
    store_sales ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
INNER JOIN 
    item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk AND item.i_manufact_id = 816
WHERE 
    dt.d_moy = 11
GROUP BY 
    dt.d_year,
    item.i_brand,
    item.i_brand_id
ORDER BY 
    dt.d_year,
    sum_agg DESC,
    brand_id
LIMIT 100
